title: An odd theory i have about the mallworld mansions.
content: Hopefully i can do this justice, bear with me folks. I'll start with real world type manors and mansions. Do you guys know how often they have stories of being haunted, having portals to the other side, the rich wives of old used to be obsessed with ghosts or the occult sarah winchester style, etc. All those types of things going on in the real world. Now transfer to mallworld mansions. How it seems a lot of our dreams here, we hop/teleport or use odd ways to travel around it like vents, mirrors, fancy stairways, hallways. I cant help but notice how a lot of these haunted mansions IRL look like my mallworld mansions. The fancy interior but somehow grimy, and mazelike as hell. Sometimes i wonder if these places DO have access to another world and merge with it... leaving a thin veil quite literally. And when we are in mallworld, we could be the ghosts in the mansions. Time and space isnt the same in mallworld, so who is to say some ghost hunters werent chasing me through the mallworld mansion and i just didnt know who they were? All the times i feel like im hiding from something or someone but i never know who lol.
